description: Total the ADR 1.1.3.6 points for a vehicle load and say whether it stays within the small-load exemption (1,000 points, or the quantity limit for one transport category), and what still applies. Covers 92 UN numbers. If any line cannot be read the whole load is refused, never totalled without it. A UN number with entries in more than one transport category needs packing_group; the response lists them.

packing_group.description: Packing group from section 14 of the safety data sheet. Needed where the UN number has entries in more than one transport category, such as 1263 paint

quantity_per_package.description: Litres or kg in each package

name: adr_1000_points
title: ADR 1.1.3.6 small-load points
